description: A React component class for managing and displaying various toast notifications (e.g., new message alerts, scroll prompts, search tips) in a Mattermost chat application. It handles toast state, rendering, user interactions, and related logic.

classes.name: ToastWrapperClass
classes.description: A React component class that manages toast notifications for new messages, unread messages, message history, and UI hints in a chat application.

methods.name: countNewMessages
methods.description: Calculates the number of new messages based on post list IDs, root posts, and whether collapsed threads are enabled.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Static lifecycle method to derive component state from incoming props, managing toast visibility and unread counts.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and updates toast status when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to toast visibility and state when component props or state change.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the component unmounts.

methods.name: handleShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts, specifically the ESC key to dismiss toasts.

methods.name: hideUnreadToast
methods.description: Hides the unread message toast.

methods.name: hideArchiveToast
methods.description: Hides the message history toast.

methods.name: hideNewMessagesToast
methods.description: Hides the new messages toast and optionally updates the last viewed bottom.

methods.name: hideSearchHintToast
methods.description: Dismisses the search tip toast.

methods.name: hideUnreadWithBottomStartToast
methods.description: Hides the toast indicating unread messages with bottom start.

methods.name: newMessagesToastText
methods.description: Generates the text/content for the new messages toast, including timestamp if width permits.

methods.name: archiveToastText
methods.description: Returns the message indicating viewing message history.

methods.name: getSearchHintToastText
methods.description: Returns the tip message for search shortcut.

methods.name: changeUrlToRemountChannelView
methods.description: Changes URL to remount the channel view, used for scrolling to new messages.

methods.name: scrollToNewMessage
methods.description: Scrolls to the latest message, remounting view if necessary.

methods.name: scrollToLatestMessages
methods.description: Scrolls to the latest messages, handling focus and view remount if needed.

methods.name: scrollToUnreadMessages
methods.description: Scrolls to unread messages.

methods.name: getToastToRender
methods.description: Determines which toast component(s) to render based on current state and props.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the toast notifications UI.
